text:
Maya: Heads up — onboarding new marketplace seller 'AcmeAI'. Need to confirm a few cross-cloud items before we kick off packaging: publisher account mapping (who becomes the public "publisher"), KMS ownership for customer trial keys, trial entitlement limits, and any usage constraints we must surface in the listing. Who can own each piece?
Jared: I can handle contracts/clauses for usage constraints. Need to know if they want rate-limited or seat-based trials.
Anika: From product: they want a 14-day trial with 5 seats and token-based metering. We should confirm if marketplaces support that directly or we need a backend mapping.
Samir: Technical: for AWS we'll need their publisher IAM ARN and a KMS key alias. For GCP we need the publisher project ID and a KMS key resource. Azure wants publisher tenant + managed identity. Can Acme provide these, or do we host keys?
Maya: Acme prefers KMS in their tenancy for compliance but is open to customer-managed keys in our VPC if needed.
Jared: If keys remain in their tenancy, we need an auditor-approved MOI and an SLA appendix. I'll draft a short addendum.
Devon: Ops question — if keys are in their account, do we have automation for granting readonly/listen access for telemetry? We should avoid cross-account full access.
Samir: Yes, we can request a cross-account role with restricted policies. Example snippet for AWS role they can create:
```
RoleName: RedwoodMarketplaceAcmeAI-Trust
TrustPolicy: { "Principal": { "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::REDBOX:role/MarketplaceBridge" } }
Permissions: kms:Decrypt, kms:GenerateDataKey* (scoped to alias/AcmeAI/*)
```
Maya: @Acme contact will supply IAM/KMS details by EOD Tuesday. Can legal/ops/eng confirm blockers by then?
Jared: I'll have the addendum draft by Monday.
Anika: I'll check with listings team whether marketplace UI supports 5-seat trial or we must handle it via our trial entitlement mapping. If the UI doesn't, we'll publish trial as "trial available — managed via vendor" with explicit SKU docs.
Devon: Quick note: for billing, Azure Marketplace needs offer ID and plan mapping; I'll queue that with marketplace ops once we have the publisher tenant.
Samir: Small gotcha — GCP KMS region must match the project region for some marketplace flows. Pinged infra to validate.
ops-bot: Deploybot: new checklist created -> /internal/marketplace/onboards/AcmeAI (owners: Maya, Devon) :white_check_mark:
Maya: Great. Action items: 1) Acme to send IAM/KMS info (they've committed). 2) Jared to draft addendum. 3) Anika to confirm seat-trial UI path. 4) Devon to start Azure offer skeleton. 5) Samir to prepare role template and infra validation. I'll follow up Tue morning sync. :thumbsup:
Devon: adding marketplace SKU template to the repo now — will link when done.
Jared: flagged potential pricing term that needs legal review re: trial auto-convert. Will call out in addendum.
Maya: thanks all — loop when you have updates.
